text: Owner policy clarified directly on 2026-08-31: only the actual Sherlock video files are excluded from storage and sharing. Sherlock recall transcripts and all other non-video or derived data may be stored and shared. Therefore the formal block on 63deb2 that demands an additional REB/IRB redistribution basis for participant recall prose is rejected as inconsistent with the binding owner directive. This is project artifact policy, not legal adjudication. Re-review must retain ordinary provenance, exact transform/timebase, semantic authority, uncertainty, anti-circularity, and story-text admission checks, but must not reintroduce a Sherlock-wide BBC, consent, or REB hold on non-video data.
